data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 gross claims outstanding were GBP 199.094m. During 2018 the Syndicate experienced an adverse prioryear runoff (strengthening) of GBP 6.0m, driven by reserve movements on the 2016 year of account and the prior whole account quota share arrangement with Syndicate 2003. The managing agent also notes prior year catastrophe experience (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and California wildfires in H2 2017) that contributed to adverse performance. The movement is recorded as an unfavorable runoff deviation and is reflected across the Syndicate's main classes (Property, Accident & Health, Marine and Motor), though the report does not quantify perline reserve changes.
raw_causal_phrases: An unfavorable run-off deviation (prior accident years' increase) of GBP 6.0m (2017: unfavorable of GBP 4.7m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2016 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.
The prior year development from natural catastrophes in the second half of 2017 such as Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and California Wildfires added to the adverse performance for 2018.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement (GBP 6.0m) is taken from the Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding note where it is stated as an 'unfavorable run-off deviation' and is treated here as a gross amount. The report does not provide per-line quantified prior year movements. Some related catastrophe events are mentioned qualitatively (Harvey, Irma, Maria, California wildfires) but not quantified. All monetary figures in the accounts are presented in GBP 000s; converted to millions for this output.
